'''R2-C2''' was a [[Color/Legends|blue]] and grey [[R2-series astromech droid/Legends|R2-series astromech droid]] serving the [[Hutt/Legends|Hutt]] [[Crime lord/Legends|crime lord]] [[Ziro Desilijic Tiure/Legends|Ziro Desilijic Tiure]] at his [[Ziro's Palace/Legends|palace]] on [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]]. It primarily served as a drink trolley at the palace's bar. Along with its blue coloring, it had a red [[Black Sun/Legends|Black Sun]] symbol on its back. On its right leg, text written in [[Galactic Basic Standard/Legends|Basic]] is visible that says "Ziro," indicating the owner.
